source.sourceCommitReason: The terminology was selected from an installed Apple SDK, not a Git source tree.

selection.description: One metadata key and three motion-context values were manually selected from the listed SDK headers for the mapping and example defined by this adapter. No full SDK vocabulary was copied.

healthkit-metadata-key.rationale: Complete describes this adapter's explicit residual-metadata allowlist of one key; it does not claim to enumerate every HealthKit metadata key.

healthkit-heart-rate-motion-context.rationale: The code system contains an adapter code for every HKHeartRateMotionContext case present in the iPhoneOS 27.0 SDK baseline.

thirdParty.attribution: HealthKit API identifiers and type names originate from Apple and are retained here to identify the platform concepts used by the interoperability mapping.
thirdParty.retainedTerminology: The terminology allowlist extracted from the hashed SDK headers contains HKMetadataKeyHeartRateMotionContext and adapter codes for the notSet, sedentary, and active cases.
thirdParty.descriptiveApiReferences: The mapping narrative and identifier definitions also refer to HKObject.uuid, HKSource.bundleIdentifier, HKSourceRevision, HKDevice, HKMetadataKeyWasUserEntered, and the three supported HKQuantityType identifiers. These references describe source fields and dispatch rules; they are not represented as a copied platform vocabulary.
thirdParty.redistributionBasis: These API identifiers and case names are reproduced only as interoperability identifiers needed to state the source mapping. The package does not reproduce Apple documentation prose, SDK implementation, or a general HealthKit vocabulary.
thirdParty.excludedMaterial: No HealthKit SDK implementation or documentation text is copied into the package.
thirdParty.repositoryLicense: The repository's MIT license applies to Grove-authored repository material; the retained Apple names remain attributed above.
